{{Top}}
'''Yuzzum''' was the native language of the [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] species from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It was a spoken musical-sounding language.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Many linguists consider that Yuzzum language was the protolanguage for [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]]; however, Yuzzum language did not evolve itself, so it coexisted with its own descendant, spoken by a different people. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] spoke this language.
